turn_text: All right, I tell you what, I know your time is limited and we want to also talk about the Ensuring Innovation Act. You recently led bipartisan effort to help lower some prescription drug costs for people. Tell us about the Ensuring Innovation Act.

I'm really excited about this that I've been working on for a couple of years and it was signed into law on Friday by President Biden. And here's the issue. I think we all know that prescription medicines just cost too much. In fact, three in 10 Americans say that they didn't fill a prescription because it was too expensive. And one of the reasons it happens is that the big drug companies have a lot of power. One of the ways they use their power is by making little changes to their drug formulations like adding salt or changing it from a pill to a gel cap. And then using that as an excuse to keep their patent, which is basically a monopoly to keep prices up. So we just said that's wrong. And we got together and wrote a bill to stop it. And that's what President Biden signed into law on Friday. It's going to help lower prescription drug prices for Minnesotans and Americans. And I think it's a really big deal.
